description: This file is a suite of shell scripts designed to test the functionality of the 'git rev-list' command. It includes various test cases covering features like object listing, pathspec handling, commit traversal options, and output formatting.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, running provided commands and verifying their success.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock, typically used to ensure unique commit timestamps.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output files.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specific path is missing in the filesystem.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines in a given output matches expected count.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit, with optional parameters, for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
